The project

From an idea to something useful.

As Robot Assembly Lead for team KE GATE, I competed in RoboSports on the Double Tennis challenge. Our team earned First Place at the World Robot Olympiad Vietnam National Round in 2026 and advanced to the International Round in Puerto Rico, scheduled for December 2026.

Current scope

The international round is upcoming. No international-round result is claimed.
